status: APPLICATION for the maintainer's decision; NOT authorized, nothing launched, no storage created
what: H1-PA's student phase: PA2v, one short L40S GPU validation; then PA2, the four trainings (D4-Original and D4-Augmented, two seeds each) and the six nucleus_v1 evaluations of eval-set-1 (those four checkpoints and PCA-Original's two, never retrained), in one cumulative envelope with the study's network volume

frozen._harness: over h1pa_governance.harness_files() on the tree this application was written from; issue() recomputes it on the session commit and the pod's setup re-checks it, so a later code change shows up as a different digest, never a silent one

scope.recipe: E1's config per seed: batch size 2, micro-batch size 1, 3 epochs, AdamW lr 5e-5, CE 0.25 + KD 1.0; D4-Original 2,916 optimizer steps, D4-Augmented 3,702 (E1's rule on its 2,468 sequences); nothing else changes
scope.evaluation: eval-set-1 every item, nucleus_v1 bound explicitly and refused when absent; the preregistered rule decides A and B, C is descriptive
not_requested: any retry of a complete valid measurement

hardware.why: measured on this exact configuration: E1 trained it on L40S at a 39.96 GB logged peak (sa train_log.jsonl) and 1.78 s per sequence pass (cost_forecast.json, n=21); full eval-set-1 evaluations ran on L40S (n=21). PA2v re-measures both under H1-PA's own inputs and nucleus_v1 before anything formal; no GPU type is assumed unsuitable without a measurement
hardware.datacenter: chosen at launch from a live query among those with L40S stock and network-volume support (2026-10-24: EU-NL-1, EUR-IS-2, US-MO-1, US-NC-1, US-TX-3, each Low); the volume is created there and locks every session to it; one GPU type for every formal unit
hardware.image: runpod/pytorch:1.1.0-cu1300-torch291-ubuntu2404 (CUDA 13: host driver >= 580); the host driver of every session is recorded

measures: seconds per optimizer step and peak GPU memory of D4-Augmented under E1's config on L40S
nucleus_v1 generation through vLLM: the protocol's identity in every summary, each item's seed, stop reasons, throughput
PCA-Original's checkpoint staged from the relay and re-identified
gpu_validation_PA2v.gate: PA2 starts only when PA2v completes with every check true; PA2 is priced from the slower of the committed L40S step rate and PA2v's; a measured rate that does not fit the envelope stops the phase and is reported

storage.period: created immediately before PA2v in the chosen datacenter; kept through PA2; at closeout its actual cost replaces the reservation. The four trained checkpoints live on it (the relay has 1.67 GiB headroom): after the result, AGENTS.md 2.5 retires them unless the maintainer names a consumer

money._need: PA2v and PA2-s20260726 at their conservative expected cost + PA2-s20260801's all-in hard bound + the storage reservation: the envelope must still cover the last session's hard bound when its authorization is issued; the cap adds $1 because an expectation is not a bound on what PA2v or the first session actually costs
money.cap_scope: CUMULATIVE over PA2v and PA2: every attempt's GPU, container disk and termination margin, and the study's storage; a rerun never receives a fresh allocation

project._: provider billing counted once (pods + network volumes, all time); the PA1 pod has posted

residual_risks: floor: under greedy decoding E1's PCA 2.96M student answered 1.75% of the static fluid items, below the 2% floor; A or B may end NOT_RESOLVED (FLOOR), which the rule reports as no evidence either way
two seeds per arm; GPU training is not bitwise deterministic, so seed variation is reported per seed and is outside the interval

E1's config saves one mid-run save point (save_every = T // 2) and is not changed: a pod lost late in a training resumes from the half-way point; the replacement subrun must fit the envelope or the phase stops and reports
L40S stock is Low in every datacenter with network volumes; a create waits at $0 rather than switching the GPU type, which needs the maintainer
one nucleus sample per item: evaluation-sampling noise is inside the item-level bootstrap, and the per-item seed is common to every checkpoint
termination_protection: one one-use authorization per session, bound to the study identity and the harness, refused at $0 when its hard cap does not fit what the cumulative envelope has left (h1pa_governance.issue)

the all-in bound (GPU + 150 GB container disk + the 1.25 min termination margin) at the launch price inside the session's cap, or no pod (h1_generation_launch.all_in_within_cap); the watchdog's hard deadline follows the accepted price
account funds and provider reconciliation before every create: only the study's volume may exist
at most one billing pod at a time; one network volume

the driver persists every checkpoint, save point and evaluation to the volume as it completes; a lost pod resumes from the last save point in a new subrun, never retraining a trained unit or re-running a scored one
the same-failure gate: a deterministic paid failure is never retried unchanged
teardown gate, the provider's confirmation that the pod is gone, a closeout per session, and the volume retired or kept by an explicit decision at the end
